record.clinical_notes: Acute onset L-sided weakness + slurred speech, onset-to-door 2h. NIHSS 12 on admission. NCCT brain: no bleed. Dx: acute ischemic stroke, R MCA territory. Within thrombolysis window, no contraindications - IV alteplase given. Partial improvement in L limb power post-lysis. Stroke unit monitoring 24h, repeat CT: no hemorrhagic transformation. DAPT + statin started at 24h. PT initiated. Discharged with residual mild L hemiparesis, OPD f/u and continued physiotherapy advised.
